nl: Rename the heading `## Logging` in docs/config.md to `## Logging and tracing`.

entries.content_utf8:
# Orders API

`GET /orders` returns all orders.
`POST /orders/new` creates an order.
Reference: http://example.com/orders/api

# Changelog

## 2.3.0

- Added the customers API.

## 2.2.0

- Added order export.

# Configuration

The service reads `config.toml` from the working directory.

## Database

Set `database.url`. The default is `sqlite://orders.db`.

## Logging

Set `log.level` to `debug`, `info` or `warn`.

# Orders service

See [installation](install.md) and [configuration](config.md).
Source code: http://example.com/orders/source

# Installation

Download the release from http://example.com/orders/releases.
Verify the checksum published at http://example.com/orders/sha256.

## Requirements

- Linux, macOS or Windows
- 512 MB of memory

docs/config.md.text:
# Configuration

The service reads `config.toml` from the working directory.

## Database

Set `database.url`. The default is `sqlite://orders.db`.

## Logging and tracing

Set `log.level` to `debug`, `info` or `warn`.

oracle_program: lines "docs/config.md" |> filter text == "## Logging" |> replace "## Logging" "## Logging and tracing" mode: literal
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('docs/config.md')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = '## Logging\n'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, '## Logging and tracing\n').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
